:::{#thm-ci-diff-means}

#### Confidence interval for a difference in means

In a linear regression model with $n$ observations and $p$ coefficients,
let $\vx$ and $\vxs$ be two covariate patterns,
let $\Delta \mu \eqdef \mu(\vx) - \mu(\vxs)$ be the difference in means between them,
and let $\widehat{\Delta \mu}$ be its estimate from the [OLS](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/correlation-regression.html#def-ols) estimate $\evb$.
A 95% [confidence interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/inference.html#def-confidence-interval) for $\Delta \mu$ is:

$$\Delta \mu \in \paren{\widehat{\Delta \mu} \pm t_{n-p}(0.975) \cdot \HSE{\widehat{\Delta \mu}}}$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-ci-diff-means, worked in @sol-ci-diff-means.

:::
